t: Radio History: The Rise, Fall and Resurrection of LORAN - Mini-Circuits Blog
s: February 17, 2021 - LORAN, a hyperbolic radio navigation system, consisted of a mobile receiver, mounted on a ship or aircraft, that detected low frequency (1850 – 1950 kHz) radio waves transmitted from land-based beacons. LORAN was revolutionary for its time due to its ability to pinpoint its location based on the time it took for a fixed transmitter’s radio waves to reach the mobile receiver.
